   119→func DecodeRLPTransaction(s *rlp.Stream, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs bool) (Transaction, error) {
   120→	kind, _, err := s.Kind()
   121→	if err != nil {
   122→		return nil, err
   123→	}
   124→	if rlp.List == kind {
   125→		txn := &LegacyTx{}
   126→		if err = txn.DecodeRLP(s); err != nil {
   127→			return nil, err
   128→		}
   129→		return txn, nil
   130→	}
   131→	if rlp.String != kind {
   132→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("not an RLP encoded transaction. If this is a canonical encoded transaction, use UnmarshalTransactionFromBinary instead. Got %v for kind, expected String", kind)
   133→	}
   134→	// Decode the EIP-2718 typed txn envelope.
   135→	var b []byte
   136→	if b, err = s.Bytes(); err != nil {
   137→		return nil, err
   138→	}
   139→	if len(b) == 0 {
   140→		return nil, rlp.EOL
   141→	}
   142→	return UnmarshalTransactionFromBinary(b, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs)
   143→}
   144→
   145→// DecodeWrappedTransaction as similar to DecodeTransaction,
   146→// but type-3 (blob) transactions are expected to be wrapped with blobs/commitments/proofs.
   147→// See https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-4844#networking
   148→func DecodeWrappedTransaction(data []byte) (Transaction, error) {
   149→	blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs := true
   150→	if len(data) == 0 {
   151→		return nil, io.EOF
   152→	}
   153→	if data[0] < 0x80 { // the encoding is canonical, not RLP
   154→		return UnmarshalTransactionFromBinary(data, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs)
   155→	}
   156→	s, done := rlp.NewStreamFromPool(bytes.NewReader(data), uint64(len(data)))
   157→	defer done()
   158→	return DecodeRLPTransaction(s, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs)
   159→}
   160→
   161→// DecodeTransaction decodes a transaction either in RLP or canonical format
   162→func DecodeTransaction(data []byte) (Transaction, error) {
   163→	blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs := false
   164→	if len(data) == 0 {
   165→		return nil, io.EOF
   166→	}
   167→	if data[0] < 0x80 { // the encoding is canonical, not RLP
   168→		return UnmarshalTransactionFromBinary(data, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs)
   169→	}
   170→	s, done := rlp.NewStreamFromPool(bytes.NewReader(data), uint64(len(data)))
   171→	defer done()
   172→	tx, err := DecodeRLPTransaction(s, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs)
   173→	if err != nil {
   174→		return nil, err
   175→	}
   176→	if s.Remaining() != 0 {
   177→		return nil, errors.New("trailing bytes after rlp encoded transaction")
   178→	}
   179→	return tx, nil
   180→}
   181→
   182→// Parse transaction without envelope.
   183→func UnmarshalTransactionFromBinary(data []byte, blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs bool) (Transaction, error) {
   184→	if len(data) <= 1 {
   185→		return nil, fmt.Errorf("short input: %v", len(data))
   186→	}
   187→	s, done := rlp.NewStreamFromPool(bytes.NewReader(data[1:]), uint64(len(data)-1))
   188→	defer done()
   189→	var t Transaction
   190→	switch data[0] {
   191→	case AccessListTxType:
   192→		t = &AccessListTx{}
   193→	case DynamicFeeTxType:
   194→		t = &DynamicFeeTransaction{}
   195→	case BlobTxType:
   196→		if blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs {
   197→			t = &BlobTxWrapper{}
   198→		} else {
   199→			t = &BlobTx{}
   200→		}
   201→	case SetCodeTxType:
   202→		t = &SetCodeTransaction{}
   203→	case AccountAbstractionTxType:
   204→		t = &AccountAbstractionTransaction{}
   205→	default:
   206→		if data[0] >= 0x80 {
   207→			// txn is type legacy which is RLP encoded
   208→			return DecodeTransaction(data)
   209→		}
   210→		return nil, ErrTxTypeNotSupported
   211→	}
   212→	if err := t.DecodeRLP(s); err != nil {
   213→		return nil, err
   214→	}
   215→	if s.Remaining() != 0 {
   216→		return nil, errors.New("trailing bytes after rlp encoded transaction")
   217→	}
   218→	return t, nil
   219→}

   221→// Removes everything but the payload body from blob tx and prepends 0x3 at the beginning - no copy
   222→// Doesn't change non-blob tx
   223→func UnwrapTxPlayloadRlp(blobTxRlp []byte) ([]byte, error) {
   224→	if blobTxRlp[0] != BlobTxType {
   225→		return blobTxRlp, nil
   226→	}
   227→	dataposPrev, _, isList, err := rlp.Prefix(blobTxRlp[1:], 0)
   228→	if err != nil || dataposPrev < 1 {
   229→		return nil, err
   230→	}
   231→	if !isList { // This is clearly not wrapped txn then
   232→		return blobTxRlp, nil
   233→	}
   234→
   235→	blobTxRlp = blobTxRlp[1:]
   236→	// Get to the wrapper list
   237→	datapos, datalen, err := rlp.ParseList(blobTxRlp, dataposPrev)
   238→	if err != nil {
   239→		return nil, err
   240→	}
   241→	blobTxRlp = blobTxRlp[dataposPrev-1 : datapos+datalen] // seekInFiles left an extra-bit
   242→	blobTxRlp[0] = 0x3
   243→	// Include the prefix part of the rlp
   244→	return blobTxRlp, nil
   245→}

   247→func MarshalTransactionsBinary(txs Transactions) ([][]byte, error) {
   248→	var err error
   249→	var buf bytes.Buffer
   250→	result := make([][]byte, len(txs))
   251→	for i := range txs {
   252→		if txs[i] == nil {
   253→			result[i] = nil
   254→			continue
   255→		}
   256→		buf.Reset()
   257→		err = txs[i].MarshalBinary(&buf)
   258→		if err != nil {
   259→			return nil, err
   260→		}
   261→		result[i] = common.CopyBytes(buf.Bytes())
   262→	}
   263→	return result, nil
   264→}
   265→
   266→func DecodeTransactions(txs [][]byte) ([]Transaction, error) {
   267→	result := make([]Transaction, len(txs))
   268→	var err error
   269→	for i := range txs {
   270→		result[i], err = UnmarshalTransactionFromBinary(txs[i], false /* blobTxnsAreWrappedWithBlobs*/)
   271→		if err != nil {
   272→			return nil, err
   273→		}
   274→	}
   275→	return result, nil
   276→}

    46→/*
    47→The State Transitioning Model
    48→
    49→A state transition is a change made when a transaction is applied to the current world state
    50→The state transitioning model does all the necessary work to work out a valid new state root.
    51→
    52→1) Nonce handling
    53→2) Pre pay gas
    54→3) Create a new state object if the recipient is \0*32
    55→4) Value transfer
    56→== If contract creation ==
    57→
    58→	4a) Attempt to run transaction data
    59→	4b) If valid, use result as code for the new state object
    60→
    61→== end ==
    62→5) Run Script section
    63→6) Derive new state root
    64→*/

   142→// ApplyMessage computes the new state by applying the given message
   143→// against the old state within the environment.
   144→//
   145→// ApplyMessage returns the bytes returned by any EVM execution (if it took place),
   146→// the gas used (which includes gas refunds) and an error if it failed. An error always
   147→// indicates a core error meaning that the message would always fail for that particular
   148→// state and would never be accepted within a block.
   149→// `refunds` is false when it is not required to apply gas refunds
   150→// `gasBailout` is true when it is not required to fail transaction if the balance is not enough to pay gas.
   151→// for trace_call to replicate OE/Parity behaviour
   152→func ApplyMessage(evm *vm.EVM, msg Message, gp *GasPool, refunds bool, gasBailout bool, engine consensus.EngineReader) (*evmtypes.ExecutionResult, error) {

   156→func applyMessage(evm *vm.EVM, msg Message, gp *GasPool, refunds bool, gasBailout bool, noFeeBurnAndTip bool, engine consensus.EngineReader) (
   157→	*evmtypes.ExecutionResult, error) {
   158→	// Only zero-gas transactions may be service ones
   159→	if msg.FeeCap().IsZero() && !msg.IsFree() && engine != nil {
   160→		blockContext := evm.Context
   161→		blockContext.Coinbase = state.SystemAddress
   162→		syscall := func(contract common.Address, data []byte) ([]byte, error) {
   163→			ret, err := SysCallContractWithBlockContext(contract, data, evm.ChainConfig(), evm.IntraBlockState(), blockContext, true, evm.Config())
   164→			return ret, err
   165→		}
   166→		msg.SetIsFree(engine.IsServiceTransaction(msg.From(), syscall))
   167→	}
   168→	st := NewStateTransition(evm, msg, gp)
   169→	st.noFeeBurnAndTip = noFeeBurnAndTip
   170→	return st.TransitionDb(refunds, gasBailout)
   171→}

   106→// LatestSigner returns the 'most permissive' Signer available for the given chain

   108→// EIP-2930 access list transactions when their respective forks are scheduled to occur at
   109→// any block number in the chain config.

   112→// have the current block number available, use MakeSigner instead.
   113→func LatestSigner(config *chain.Config) *Signer {
   114→	var signer Signer
   115→	signer.unprotected = true
   116→	chainId, overflow := uint256.FromBig(config.ChainID)
   117→	if overflow {

   120→	signer.chainID.Set(chainId)
   121→	signer.chainIDMul.Lsh(chainId, 1) // ×2
   122→	if config.ChainID != nil {

   125→		}
   126→		if config.LondonBlock != nil {
   127→			signer.dynamicFee = true

   131→		}
   132→		if config.SpuriousDragonBlock != nil {

   134→		}
   135→		if config.PragueTime != nil {
   136→			signer.setCode = true
